facts.fact: A service voter's proxy appointment application must reach the Returning Officer before the last date for filing nomination papers
facts.quote: Application for appointment of a proxy should be received by the Returning Officer before the last date of filing of nomination papers.

facts.fact: A revocation of the proxy takes effect from the date the Returning Officer receives it
facts.quote: Revocation will become effective from the date it is received by the Returning Officer.

summary: Confirmed in ECI's electoral roll FAQ (Q64-Q65).
